description: The Stadhuis at Sneek shows the rococo street front of 1760-1763, with the stone stair and balcony of 1745 kept in front. A hipped roof carries a small octagonal cupola. It is overcast, about 13.0°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The offices are closed. The coat of arms is not readable. The Waterpoort is another scene and is not in this frame.
